title: The comment-narration check stops flagging a review round written inside or beside a decision gloss
why: #1840's fresh round 1 left three findings in lint/check_comment_narration.py (lane comment-check-scans-shell, session_013NEJL37UFXTQuAcox7s8fD, 04:14 CST Nov 8). Finding 2 is a false alarm Claude can hit in normal work.
note: Fix: (1) ROUND, near :58-60: `(decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3, review round 3)` still flags inside a gloss, because the "review round" alternative takes the digits; skip it inside a gloss as the decision-id case does. (2) OPENS, near :63: `(see decision X, round 3)`, `(decision X: ... round 3)` and `Holds a change after round 3 (decision X).` flag; treat a round that the same parenthesis or sentence ties to a decision id as a gloss. (3) near :82-88: only the checked repo's docs/decisions counts, so a pinning repo cannot gloss a claude-settings decision; also read the pinned claude-settings decisions. Red cases first: each form above flags today; control: plain history narration ("fixed in round 2") still flags. Related: steps narration-check-rule-quotes (#1840) and narration-gloss-id-test (#1856); the fourth finding is already in note comment-narration-limits. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 04:24 CST Nov 8.
